assertions.title: No transparency backgrounds

steps.action: Search frontend CSS/TSX/TS for rgba(alpha) and slash-alpha background utilities
steps.observed: No rgba(alpha) backgrounds were found, but slash-alpha utility backgrounds were still present.

steps.expected: Panels use solid dark backgrounds only
steps.observed: WorldSimulation.tsx still uses bg-white/70, bg-sky-50/70, and bg-white/55; PresenceCallDeck.tsx still uses bg-white/5, bg-black/40, bg-[#a6e22e]/10, bg-[#f92672]/10, and bg-transparent.

assertions.issues: Semi-transparent backgrounds remain in live panel TSX code, so the UI is not fully on solid dark surfaces.

steps.action: Search frontend CSS/TSX/TS for backdrop-filter, blur(), backdrop-blur, and blur-*
Review remaining backdrop/glass naming hits separately
steps.expected: Only implementation evidence should fail this assertion
steps.observed: Remaining backdrop/glass strings are naming/text residue, not blur-based styling.

assertions.title: No galaxy/parallax backgrounds

steps.action: Search frontend CSS/TSX/TS for parallax, vignette, galaxy, star-field, and radial-gradient residue
steps.expected: No cosmic background treatment or related control residue remains
steps.observed: No parallax/star-field hits were found, but vignette controls, galaxy labels, and a radial-gradient overlay were still present.

steps.expected: No inline cosmic gradients or galaxy/vignette UI residue remains
steps.observed: Canvas.tsx still renders a radial-gradient overlay; coreSimulationConfig.ts and useSimulationTuning.ts still expose vignette tuning; GalaxyModelDock.tsx and CoreBackdrop.tsx still carry galaxy wording.

assertions.issues: Cosmic visual residue persists in inline TSX gradients and in active vignette/galaxy-related runtime naming.

steps.action: Inspect base typography declarations in index.css
steps.expected: Base font size falls in the 14-16px range
steps.observed: body is set to 14px in index.css.

steps.action: Search for 10px/11px text declarations in CSS/TSX/TS
steps.observed: No 10px/11px text declarations were found; smallest observed text utilities were 12px/text-xs.

steps.action: Search frontend CSS/TSX/TS for mindfuck residue
steps.expected: No mindfuck-* classes or references remain

steps.observed: Selectors are descriptive, e.g. simulation-core-*, world-panel-*, world-focus-*, dashboard-*.

frictions.description: This group was assigned to the repo-shell surface, so screenshot/browser evidence from the UI was out of scope even though the contract describes screenshot examples.
frictions.resolution: Captured shell-based evidence files and source excerpts under the assigned mission evidence directory instead.

summary: Tested 5 UI style residue assertions via repo-shell inspection: 3 passed (VAL-UI-002/004/005) and 2 failed (VAL-UI-001/003). Failures were caused by remaining semi-transparent backgrounds plus surviving cosmic gradient/vignette/galaxy residue in frontend TSX/config code.
